title: Ye keh rahe hai aaj bhi naale furaat ke
body:
Ye keh rahe hai aaj bhi naale furaat ke
pyaase rahe khareedne waale furaat ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Garmi thi karbala ke bayabaa'n me is qadar
khud pad gaye the seene me chaale furaat ke
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ka tha bayaa'n abhi kamsin hai mere laal
kardena tashnagi ko hawaale furaat ke
<<DIVIDER>>
ab taaba hashr hoga na paani kisi pa band
khulwa diye hussain ne taale furaat ke
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas apni qabr banaakar labe furaat
armaan tum ne qoob nikaale furaat ke
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqaaye ahlebait ki raaho me ae 'sarosh'
Aankhe bicha rahe the ujaale furaat ke
